page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page0:1

page1.text:
I murmur those words like a prayer.
My life doesn't matter anymore.
But to put a stop to this savage brutality...
"No...COME...SABER!!!"
I muster up all my strength and call for my blade.
One of my Command Spell strokes disappears.
At that very moment, the space around me begins to waver.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page1:1

page2.text:
So this is magic.
Saber, clad in her silver armor, bursts through the ripples in space and time to appear before me.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page2:1

page3.text:
"Gah...ha...!"
My back slams into the ground.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page3:1

page4.text:
"Ah...ha...aaahhhh...!"
I stop breathing.
The force of impact jars every bone and organ in my body.
Several ribs crack, or probably break outright.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page4:1

page5.text:
"Ah...hh...ggh!"
And yet...
...my body is intact. My bloody arms are still attached.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page5:1

page6.text:
"Shirou!"
Saber runs to me.
Forcing my numb limbs to move, I push to my feet to show her that I'm all right.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page6:1

page7.text:
"There's no time to explain. You understand what's happening, right, Saber?"
"Please wait, Shirou. I do understand, but first, your body must—"
"Take care of Rider. Only you can beat her."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page7:1

page8.text:
"I cannot. Treating you is my first priority. You will not survive these wounds."
"No. There's something else that needs doing first."
We need to beat Shinji and Rider. As quickly as possible.
Nothing is more important.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page8:1

page9.text:
"But if I do that..."
Saber is focused only on me.
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't happy about that.
But there's no time to argue.
If Saber doesn't want to listen, I just need to use my second Command Spell.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page9:1

page10.text:
"...Hn."
She must have understood my resolve.
Saber reluctantly accepts my decision.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page10:1

page11.text:
"Understood. Master, your orders."
"Defeat Rider. I'll handle Shinji."
Saber does not hesitate.
She nods and, without another word, turns toward the school building like a whirlwind.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-09:page11:1
